reason: Night-shift cohort profile: DNA methylation was measured in a subset, but the abstract reports no analysis relating that marker to shift work, so I cannot tell whether this is an analytic primary study or a resource description.

Case-control diagnostic study measuring cfDNA methylation at gastric-cancer-specific DMPs in patients and controls to build an early-detection assay.

Retrospective series of 49 pineal tumour patients with EPIC methylation-array classification and survival comparisons by age and metastatic status, linking methylation to diagnostic classification.

Two-sample Mendelian randomisation using genetic summary statistics for epigenetic clocks and lifespan, analysing no individual-level data.

Secondary analysis of an RCT of early intervention in preterm infants with LINE1 promoter methylation measured in buccal swabs at 5-6 years.
Matched-pair study of breast cancer patients in which gamma-H2AX was assayed in blood cells as a predictor of late radiation fibrosis, a treatment-related clinical decision.
Biological age was represented by a deficit-accumulation frailty index; no epigenetic marker was measured.
Biological age was computed by the Klemera-Doubal method from composite clinical biomarkers, not from any measured epigenetic marker.
Feasibility cluster-controlled trial of a community dance programme in older adults listing DNA methylation among the measured outcomes.
Longitudinal cohort of 159 perinatal women with ESR1, ESR2 and GPER methylation measured in dried blood spots and related to depressive symptoms.

Preclinical study of WEE1 inhibition with chromatin accessibility sequencing in laboratory models, whose only human clinical evidence is a single patient's response.
Cross-sectional reference-value study of high-sensitivity cardiac troponin T with no epigenetic marker measured.

Prospective mother-child cohort measuring targeted bisulfite-sequenced methylation in hypertension-related genes as a mediator between prenatal phthalate exposure and blood pressure.
Molecular profiling reported fusion genes and copy-number losses of chromatin-remodelling genes; no DNA methylation, histone mark or chromatin state was measured.
Case-control of 272 MASLD-HCC cases and 316 controls with 850k-array DNA methylation used to derive epigenetic clocks for HCC risk stratification.
Retrospective cohort of 101 glioblastoma patients with qMSP MGMT promoter methylation used for prognostic and treatment-related stratification.
Cross-sectional comparison of blood genome-wide DNA methylation in Native Hawaiian and White women, with CpGs related to DASH dietary adherence and metabolic biomarkers.
Biological age was derived by a neural network from surface ECGs; no epigenetic marker was measured.
Cross-sectional study of 205 women exposed to biomass smoke measuring mtDNA methylation in relation to that exposure and to breast cancer risk prediction.
Epigenome-wide association analyses in two population-based samples relating measured blood DNA methylation to air pollution and structural discrimination exposures.
Cross-sectional study of 1413 childhood cancer survivors with epigenetic age acceleration from five DNAm clocks related to neurocognitive function and risk identification.

Mendelian randomisation, LDSC and colocalization analyses drawing on GWAS and methylation summary statistics rather than individual-level data.
Case-control EWAS of 24 cancer patients on antiresorptive therapy with EPIC-array methylation compared between MRONJ cases and controls.
Multi-cohort case-control measuring HECW2 and GDAP1 DNA methylation by pyrosequencing in human blood and postmortem brain in relation to alcohol use disorder.
Age- and sex-matched case-control of 192 participants measuring DRD4 promoter methylation by pyrosequencing in relation to mild cognitive impairment.
Cross-sectional analysis of 281 Black inpatients with bisulfite-sequencing-derived cell-type-specific DNA methylation related to 24-hour blood pressure phenotypes.
Prospective HRS cohort of 2112 participants with EPIC-array DNA methylation aging algorithms related to incident cardiovascular disease for risk stratification.

Case-control liquid biopsy study profiling cfDNA methylation by cfMeDIP-seq in 145 plasma samples for esophageal cancer detection.
Genome-wide DNA methylation in MEF2C-variant patients versus controls used to derive and test a diagnostic episignature classifier.
Biological age acceleration was computed from phenotypic and Klemera-Doubal clinical biomarker algorithms, with no epigenetic marker measured.

Retrospective cohort of 198 resected pancreatic cancers with gamma-H2AX assayed in tumour tissue and used to predict benefit from platinum-based chemotherapy at recurrence.
